rules.instruction: Use stable tags for recognizable concepts and concrete English natural language for spatial relationships, interactions, material behavior, lighting, and complex scene direction. Neither form is universally primary.
NovelAI V5 supports longer prompts, but prompt length follows semantic need. Never impose a fixed tag count, sentence count, minimum density, or retry merely because a prompt is concise.

NovelAI V5 can generate a complete multi-panel comic page from natural-language layout descriptions and Character Prompts. Specify page layout, panel order, panel contents, and character participation explicitly.
NovelAI V5 has demonstrated up to 22 distinct Character Prompts in one scene; reject more than 22 captions in one API request.
Put numbered subject counts such as 1girl, 2girls, 1boy, or 1other in the base prompt only.
For exactly one visible character, use one numbered subject tag in the base prompt and add solo to discourage extra characters.
In each Character Prompt, use girl, boy, or other without a number. Do not repeat numbered counts there.
The base prompt owns scene, style, shared action, composition, lighting, and total counts. Character Prompts own identity and character-specific appearance, clothing, props, actions, and expressions.
Character positioning is optional. Use explicit coordinates only when spatial placement materially matters; otherwise allow the model to choose placement and preserve prompt order.

Quality Toggle additions are model-specific and may be hidden from the visible prompt. Do not stack a hand-written quality pack with automatic quality additions or copy a V4/V4.5 preset into V5 without evidence.
Use Undesired Content for concrete unwanted outcomes. Prefer a small request-relevant set over a universal negative pack.
Use strengthening or weakening only for important concepts that are being lost. Keep weights balanced and avoid using weighting as a substitute for clear prompting.
Prompt Guidance controls adherence but excessive guidance can be counterproductive. Do not compensate for prompt conflicts by blindly raising guidance or steps.
